intent: Eight original friendship-email tasks separate a guess from a reported explanation, construct a three-step information sequence, choose opposite game/gate pictures for different times, assign requests and commitments to the right person, preserve an unconfirmed invitation and respect alternative plans. Fresh shared-drawing dialogue distinguishes agreed storage and notice of moves from a ban or ownership change.
picturePurpose: Original board-game versus school-gate art supplies activity/place identities only. Text establishes time, reported reason, request ownership and invitation status; pixels do not establish motives, kinship or acceptance.

workshop.title: 先问清楚，别急着猜：读懂朋友的消息
workshop.instruction: 排清楚发生的事和后来知道的信息，再分清邀请、请求、承诺与确认。

items.label: 猜测和解释要分开
items.prompt: What did May first think, and what reason did Leo later give?
items.answer: May thought Leo was angry; Leo explained that he had to meet his younger brother at the gate.
items.reason: “他生气了”是May最初的猜测；去校门接弟弟是Leo后来给出的解释。不能把她的猜测当成他的真实想法，也不能凭离开就判断他讨厌朋友。
items.hint: 分清她的猜测、他的解释、提出的请求和还没确认的计划。
items.material:
AN EMAIL ABOUT YESTERDAY
Hi Leo,
Yesterday, you left our board game without telling me where you were going.
At first, I thought you were angry with me.
Later, you explained that you had to meet your younger brother at the school gate.
I should have asked you instead of guessing.
Next time, could you tell me before you leave?
I will ask a clear question if I do not understand.
Would you like to play a board game at lunchtime tomorrow?
It is fine if you already have another plan.
Please let me know whether you can join, so we can plan our lunch break.
May

transfer.passage:
A PLACE FOR SHARED WORK
Kai cannot find the drawing he and Xiu made together. He guesses that Xiu has kept it for herself. Xiu explains, "I put it in the blue folder on the shelf to keep it dry. I should have told you." Kai thanks her for explaining. They agree to keep shared drawings in that folder and tell each other whenever either person moves one. They do not agree that shared work must never be moved.
transfer.stem: Which statement accurately describes their new agreement?

options.text: Shared drawings must never be moved, even when both friends know where they are.
They use an agreed place and tell each other about moves; the drawing may still be moved.
Xiu now owns the drawings alone because she put this one in a folder.

answer.display: They use an agreed place and tell each other about moves; the drawing may still be moved.

explanation.strategy: 先把猜测与解释分开，再核对协议允许什么、要求什么。

steps.text: Kai猜画被据为己有；Xiu解释是放进蓝色文件夹防潮。猜测不能替代后来的解释。
steps.reason: 原文没有把共享作品的所有权改成Xiu独有。

steps.text: 协议规定共同存放的位置，并要求谁移动作品就告诉对方。
steps.reason: 固定存放位置与告知移动是两项互相配合的要求。

steps.text: 协议没有禁止一切移动，所以应保留“可以移动，但要告知”的范围。
steps.reason: 不能把告知条件改成永远不许移动。

distractors.reason: 把“移动时告诉对方”扩大成任何情况下都不许移动，与末句不符。
把保管地点误当成独占所有权；原文一直把作品称为共享作品。

explanation.pitfall: 别把“我以为”当事实，也别把有条件的约定改成绝对禁止。

segments.text: not a ban on all moves

visual.caption: 双方把位置和告知方式说清楚；放进文件夹不改变共享作品的归属。
